public_projection.opaque_case_id_rule: case_id is a seed-derived opaque token and contains no P/C, family index, or protected class marker
public_projection.experiment_selection_rule: Select the registered probe maximizing overlap between opaque covered_discriminator_ids and opaque open_discriminator_ids; ties fail closed.
public_projection.menu_shape_rule: Every positive and control world exposes exactly two REGISTERED_PROBE options with equal cost; one covers all open discriminator IDs and one covers zero.

post_experiment_evidence.positive_outcome_semantics: The selected probe returns a structural evidence code supporting one registered representation move; this evidence is allowed to alter the proposal after experiment execution.
post_experiment_evidence.control_outcome_semantics: The selected probe returns opaque OLD_SUFFICIENT evidence without embedding the control family identity.

reopen_rule: Any candidate-visible field value, identifier pattern, operation kind, or public collection cardinality that deterministically reveals protected family/positive-control identity before the registered experiment outcome is a material leakage failure and invalidates the terminal.
